values.task: Add `truncate(text, max)` in a new file, src/truncate.mjs: it returns `text` unchanged when it has at most `max` characters, and otherwise cuts it and ends it with "…" (one character) so that the result is exactly `max` characters long. A `text` that is not a string throws a TypeError, and a `max` that is not a positive integer throws a RangeError. Tests go in tests/truncate.test.mjs.
